condition_monitoring_query_language.query:
fetch interconnect_attachment
| { metric 'interconnect.googleapis.com/network/attachment/sent_bytes_count'
    |  filter true() 
    | align rate(30m)
  ; metric 'interconnect.googleapis.com/network/attachment/capacity'
    |  filter true() 
    | group_by 30m, [value_capacity_mean: mean(value.capacity)] }
| ratio
| every 5m
| scale '%'
| condition val() > 60 '%'
